items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: Charles Davis, and I used to go down there, he would speak Italian, with the proprietor

ctx.x: He used to have, good stuffed crab, and had a barbershop, in the back. Charles Davis, and I used to go down there, he would speak Italian, with the proprietor, and he would knock 15% off the bill.
Oh, good. Well, these last few summers, you say five summers, you've been here.
